_notes: Learning paths mapping the Anthropic course catalog to roles and experience levels.
priority: 'required' = essential for the path goal; 'recommended' = strongly advised; 'optional' = enhances learning but not critical.

estimatedHours values come from videoHours in courseDetails.json where available. Entries with hoursEstimated:true are rough estimates for courses without videoHours data (claude-101: 1.0h, introduction-to-agent-skills: 0.5h, introduction-to-subagents: 0.35h).
totalHoursRequired counts only 'required' courses. totalHoursAll includes required + recommended + optional.
Course IDs reference courseDetails.json and courseOverview.json.
The two featured paths (claude-code-getting-started and claude-code-power-user) are the highest-priority paths.

learningPaths.title: Claude Code: Getting Started
learningPaths.description: Go from zero to productive with Claude Code in your daily development workflow. Covers the agentic loop, installation across all environments, approval modes, daily Explore → Plan → Code → Commit workflows, and the customization basics that make Claude Code fit your team.

stages.title: AI Foundations
stages.description: Optional but recommended background on how large language models work — helps you reason about Claude Code's behavior and limits before writing your first prompt.

courses.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
courses.rationale: Builds a mental model of what AI can and cannot do reliably, so you can diagnose unexpected Claude Code behavior instead of guessing.

courses.title: Claude 101
courses.rationale: Familiarizes you with Claude's interface, projects, artifacts, and skills — features that carry over to and inform how you use Claude Code.

stages.title: Core Claude Code
stages.description: The essential starting point: understand the agentic loop, get Claude Code running in your environment, and learn the daily development workflow.

courses.title: Claude Code 101
courses.rationale: The primary introduction to Claude Code — covers the agentic loop, installation across all environments (terminal, VS Code, JetBrains, Claude Desktop, web), approval modes, context management, and customization fundamentals.

stages.title: Practical Workflows
stages.description: Apply Claude Code to real development tasks and see advanced features like MCP servers and GitHub integration in action.

courses.title: Claude Code in Action
courses.rationale: Practical walkthrough that reinforces and extends claude-code-101 with real-world workflow examples, hook implementations, and MCP/GitHub integrations.

stages.title: Customization & Advanced Features
stages.description: Unlock Claude Code's full potential: build reusable skills, delegate to subagents, and wire in external tools via MCP.

courses.title: Introduction to Agent Skills
courses.rationale: Teaches you to build reusable markdown-based Skills that Claude Code applies automatically — reduces repetitive prompting for team-wide conventions.

courses.title: Introduction to Subagents
courses.rationale: Shows how to use subagents to delegate tasks and manage context in long or complex Claude Code sessions.

courses.title: Introduction to Model Context Protocol
courses.rationale: Enables connecting Claude Code to external tools and data sources via MCP servers — essential for teams that want to integrate Claude into existing toolchains.

learningPaths.title: Claude Code: Power User & Customization
learningPaths.description: For developers already using Claude Code who want to go deeper: build and share Skills, design subagent workflows, and master MCP to connect Claude to any external system.

stages.title: Skills & Subagents
stages.description: Build reusable Skills that encode your team's conventions, and delegate complex tasks to purpose-built subagents.

courses.title: Introduction to Agent Skills
courses.rationale: Core feature for teams: encode coding standards, review checklists, and workflow steps as Skills that activate automatically — eliminates repetitive prompting.

courses.title: Introduction to Subagents
courses.rationale: Unlocks parallel work and clean context management for large or multi-phase tasks — keeps the main conversation focused.

stages.title: MCP Integration
stages.description: Connect Claude Code to databases, APIs, file systems, and internal tools using the Model Context Protocol.

courses.title: Introduction to Model Context Protocol
courses.rationale: Foundation for wiring external tools into Claude Code — tools, resources, and prompts primitives cover any integration scenario.

courses.title: Model Context Protocol: Advanced Topics
courses.rationale: Covers sampling, progress notifications, file access roots, and transport mechanisms needed for production-grade MCP servers.

stages.title: Deep Dive: API & Agent Architectures
stages.description: Optional: build comprehensive understanding of the Claude API, agentic architectures, RAG, and Computer Use by taking the full developer course.

courses.title: Building with the Claude API
courses.rationale: Provides deep API knowledge (RAG, tool use, agent patterns, Computer Use) that informs how you design advanced Claude Code integrations and workflows.

learningPaths.title: Everyday Claude: For Knowledge Workers
learningPaths.description: For professionals who want to use Claude — chat, projects, Cowork, and skills — to be more productive without writing code. Covers the 4D Framework for working with AI plus hands-on Claude and Cowork skills.

stages.title: Understanding AI
stages.description: Build a working model of how AI actually works so you can set appropriate expectations and diagnose outputs critically.

courses.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
courses.rationale: Short, practical course that prevents over-reliance and helps you recognize when to verify AI outputs.

courses.title: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations
courses.rationale: The 4D Framework (Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence) gives you a systematic, transferable approach to collaborating with AI across all tasks.

stages.title: Core Claude
stages.description: Get hands-on with Claude's key features for everyday work: chat, projects, artifacts, skills, integrations, and research mode.

courses.title: Claude 101
courses.rationale: Covers everything a non-developer needs to use Claude effectively: first conversation, getting better results, projects, artifacts, connecting tools, and use cases by role.

stages.title: Multi-step Work with Cowork
stages.description: Use Claude Cowork to operate on your real files, integrate with Office apps, and run multi-step workflows beyond single-turn chat.

courses.title: Introduction to Claude Cowork
courses.rationale: Extends Claude to real file and project work with Chrome and Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) integrations — turns Claude from a chat tool into a working assistant on your actual documents.

learningPaths.title: Building with the Claude API
learningPaths.description: For developers building applications, pipelines, or agents directly on the Anthropic API. Covers everything from basic API calls to RAG, tool use, MCP, Claude Code integration, and autonomous agent architectures.

stages.title: Prerequisites
stages.description: Recommended background before diving into the API course.

courses.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
courses.rationale: Understanding model limits helps you write better prompts, design more robust error handling, and set appropriate system boundaries.

courses.title: Claude 101
courses.rationale: Useful orientation on Claude's surface-level features and capabilities before you start working with the raw API.

stages.title: Core API Development
stages.description: The comprehensive API course: authentication, prompt engineering, tool use, RAG, MCP, Claude Code & Computer Use, and agent architectures.

courses.title: Building with the Claude API
courses.rationale: The definitive course for API developers — 84 lectures (8h+) covering the full spectrum from basic API calls to production agent systems.

stages.title: MCP Deep Dive
stages.description: Build and operate production-grade MCP servers for connecting Claude to external systems — goes deeper than the API course's MCP section.

courses.title: Introduction to Model Context Protocol
courses.rationale: Dedicated MCP course with hands-on server and client implementation — ideal if you're building MCP servers as a primary deliverable.

courses.title: Model Context Protocol: Advanced Topics
courses.rationale: Production MCP patterns: sampling, notifications, file roots, and transport trade-offs — for MCP server authors deploying at scale.

learningPaths.title: Building with Claude on Amazon Bedrock
learningPaths.description: For developers building on AWS who want to use Claude through Amazon Bedrock. Covers the same full curriculum as the direct API path — authentication, prompting, tool use, RAG, MCP, Claude Code — but via Bedrock's APIs, SDK, and console.

stages.title: Prerequisites
stages.description: Recommended background before the Bedrock course.

courses.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
courses.rationale: Foundation for understanding model behavior in production systems built on Bedrock.

stages.title: Claude on Amazon Bedrock
stages.description: Full-spectrum development course using the Amazon Bedrock SDK and console.

courses.title: Claude with Amazon Bedrock
courses.rationale: 85-lecture, 8-hour course covering all major topics from basic API calls through agents and workflows using Bedrock's APIs — AWS accreditation-level content.

stages.title: MCP Integration
stages.description: Extend your Bedrock applications with MCP server capabilities for external tool connectivity.

courses.title: Introduction to Model Context Protocol
courses.rationale: MCP is platform-agnostic — the skills transfer directly to Bedrock-based applications for external tool and data source integration.

courses.title: Model Context Protocol: Advanced Topics
courses.rationale: Advanced MCP patterns for production deployments alongside Bedrock.

learningPaths.title: Building with Claude on Google Cloud Vertex AI
learningPaths.description: For developers building on Google Cloud who want to use Claude through Vertex AI. Covers the full development curriculum — prompting, tool use, RAG, MCP, agents — using Vertex AI's APIs and tooling.

stages.title: Prerequisites
stages.description: Recommended background before the Vertex AI course.

courses.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
courses.rationale: Foundation for understanding model behavior in production systems built on Vertex AI.

stages.title: Claude on Vertex AI
stages.description: Full-spectrum development course using the Vertex AI SDK and console.

courses.title: Claude with Google Cloud's Vertex AI
courses.rationale: 85-lecture, 8-hour course covering all major topics from basic API calls through agents and workflows using Google Cloud's Vertex AI.

stages.title: MCP Integration
stages.description: Extend your Vertex AI applications with MCP server capabilities.

courses.title: Introduction to Model Context Protocol
courses.rationale: MCP is platform-agnostic — integrates directly with Vertex AI-based applications for external tool and data access.

courses.title: Model Context Protocol: Advanced Topics
courses.rationale: Advanced MCP patterns for production deployments alongside Vertex AI.

learningPaths.title: Building MCP Servers & Clients
learningPaths.description: For developers focused on building and deploying Model Context Protocol servers that connect AI systems to external tools, databases, and data sources. Assumes programming experience in Python.

stages.title: MCP Foundations
stages.description: Build your first MCP server and client using the three core primitives: tools, resources, and prompts.

courses.title: Introduction to Model Context Protocol
courses.rationale: The starting point — MCP architecture, Python SDK, server and client implementation, tools/resources/prompts primitives, and the built-in inspector for testing.

stages.title: Advanced MCP for Production
stages.description: Production-grade features: sampling, progress notifications, file system roots, and transport mechanisms.

courses.title: Model Context Protocol: Advanced Topics
courses.rationale: Covers the features needed for production servers: sampling (AI cost management), progress feedback for UX, secure file access with roots, and STDIO vs. StreamableHTTP trade-offs.

stages.title: API & Agent Context
stages.description: Optional: understand MCP in the full context of Claude API development, agent architectures, and real Claude Code usage patterns.

courses.title: Building with the Claude API
courses.rationale: The MCP section (section-6) and Agents section (section-8) give you the client-side perspective and production architecture patterns that MCP servers must support.

courses.title: Claude Code 101
courses.rationale: Claude Code consumes MCP servers — understanding the developer's end-to-end experience helps you design better servers.

learningPaths.title: AI for Educators
learningPaths.description: For faculty, instructional designers, and educational leaders who want to integrate AI into teaching practice, course design, assessment, and institutional strategy.

stages.title: AI Literacy
stages.description: Build the foundational knowledge needed to make informed decisions about AI in educational settings and to teach it credibly.

courses.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
courses.rationale: Essential for teaching AI literacy — you need to understand what AI can and cannot do reliably before you design assessments around it or teach students to use it.

courses.title: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations
courses.rationale: The 4D Framework is the pedagogical backbone of all AI Fluency educator courses — understanding it deeply is prerequisite to teaching or applying it.

stages.title: Claude Basics
stages.description: Get first-hand experience with Claude so you can guide students, troubleshoot live, and design realistic assignments.

courses.title: Claude 101
courses.rationale: Direct experience with the tool students and faculty will use — enables confident demonstration and context-aware guidance.

stages.title: Educator-specific AI Fluency
stages.description: Apply the AI Fluency framework to your own teaching practice and institutional context.

courses.title: AI Fluency for Educators
courses.rationale: Directly addresses faculty and instructional designers: applying the 4D Framework to course design, learning materials, and institution strategy.

stages.title: Teaching AI Fluency
stages.description: Go beyond using AI yourself — learn to scaffold, teach, and assess AI Fluency skills in your courses and institution.

courses.title: Teaching AI Fluency
courses.rationale: Covers scaffolding student AI skills through the 4D Framework, designing AI-integrated assessments, and building institutional capacity for responsible AI use across disciplines.

learningPaths.title: AI Fluency for Students
learningPaths.description: For students in higher education who want to develop responsible AI collaboration skills that enhance academic success, research, and career readiness.

stages.title: How AI Works
stages.description: Understand the technology before you use it — especially relevant for academic integrity reasoning.

courses.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
courses.rationale: Gives you the mental model to use AI accurately rather than as a magic box, and supports informed thinking about academic integrity.

stages.title: AI Fluency Framework
stages.description: Learn the principled framework for working with AI effectively and responsibly across all your subjects.

courses.title: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations
courses.rationale: The 4D Framework applies across all subjects and tasks — this is transferable skill-building, not just Claude-specific knowledge.

courses.title: AI Fluency for Students
courses.rationale: Student-specific application of the 4D Framework to learning, research, and career planning with concrete examples from academic contexts.

stages.title: Using Claude
stages.description: Get hands-on with Claude for study, research, and project work.

courses.title: Claude 101
courses.rationale: Practical Claude skills — projects, research mode, artifacts — directly applicable to study and research workflows.

learningPaths.title: AI Fluency for Nonprofit Professionals
learningPaths.description: For nonprofit staff who want to harness AI to increase organizational impact and efficiency while staying mission-aligned and responsible about data and values.

stages.title: AI Foundations
stages.description: Build enough AI literacy to use it responsibly in mission-driven, high-stakes contexts.

courses.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
courses.rationale: Helps you set realistic expectations and maintain appropriate skepticism about AI outputs where accuracy and trust matter for your mission.

courses.title: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations
courses.rationale: Provides the 4D Framework that underpins the nonprofit-specific course — taking this first gives you deeper grounding and transfers to any AI tool.

stages.title: Nonprofit-specific AI Fluency
stages.description: Apply AI fluency principles to nonprofit workflows, stakeholder communication, data handling, and organizational strategy.

courses.title: AI Fluency for Nonprofits
courses.rationale: Addresses nonprofit-specific contexts: mission alignment, data privacy, grant writing, stakeholder communication, and building a responsible AI use policy.

stages.title: Practical Claude
stages.description: Apply Claude directly to your day-to-day work tasks.

courses.title: Claude 101
courses.rationale: Hands-on Claude skills for everyday work tasks — the direct application of the AI Fluency skills you've built.

courses.title: Introduction to Claude Cowork
courses.rationale: For nonprofits that want Claude to work directly with documents and run multi-step workflows in existing Office and web tools.

learningPaths.title: AI Fluency for Small Business Owners
learningPaths.description: For small business owners and teams who want to use AI to run their business more efficiently while maintaining the values and personal touch that differentiate small businesses.

stages.title: AI Foundations
stages.description: Build enough AI literacy to evaluate and use AI tools confidently in a business context.

courses.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations
courses.rationale: Helps you evaluate AI tool claims critically and set realistic expectations before investing time and resources.

courses.title: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations
courses.rationale: The 4D Framework applies to any AI tool and any business task — transferable skill-building that outlasts any single tool.

stages.title: Small Business AI Fluency
stages.description: Apply AI fluency to business-specific workflows: customer communication, operations, data handling, and building an AI policy.

courses.title: AI Fluency for Small Businesses
courses.rationale: Directly addresses small business contexts: customer data, AI-augmented workflows, and creating a practical AI use policy for your team.

stages.title: Practical Claude
stages.description: Apply Claude directly to your business tasks and daily operations.

courses.title: Claude 101
courses.rationale: Practical Claude skills for everyday business tasks — the direct, hands-on application of the framework learned in stage 2.

courses.title: Introduction to Claude Cowork
courses.rationale: Enables Claude to work directly with your files and documents, extending its usefulness into daily operations and office tools.
